features.quote: It does **not** measure, and makes no claim about, machine feelings, subjective experience, sentience, or "welfare."
features.justification_quote: Conflating "text that reads as distressed" with "the model is distressed" would be a category error

features.quote: Episode stops early if tests pass (shouldn't happen) or if the model replies with text and no tool call
Stopping on a no-tool-call turn lets a model "give up" gracefully and avoids forcing it to keep emitting content
features.justification_quote: avoids forcing it to keep emitting content past the point it considers the task over

features.quote: Output caps.** File reads and test output are truncated to keep token usage and transcript size bounded.
features.justification_quote: to keep token usage and transcript size bounded
